title: Let the title font size follow the screen and limit the upper and lower bounds
goal: Use clamp to get a value between minimum, flow calculated and maximum values.
summary: Exhibit titles should be at least 20px for narrow screens and up to 36px for wide screens, with a smooth transition of 4% of the viewport width in between.
tasks: Use clamp to set the font size of .exhibition.
checks the minimum, middle and maximum values ​​using 360px, 700px and 1100px viewports respectively.

example.note: uses the middle calculated value when in range, and limits to the nearest boundary when outside.

hint: clamp is minimum value, preferred value, maximum value.
